v40_9_reproducibility_note: The original Loop 4 JSON (commit c726225) was produced by a script that was not committed. The sigma_eff values that would give those t_c values do not match any standard sigma_m formula at the relevant velocities. This reproduction uses the canonical Gaussian (project fallback) and NOTES the discrepancy with the original JSON. The qualitative conclusion ('t_c >> Hubble time for all 5 UFDs') is unchanged.

nemotron_v40_9_findings_applied.Q3: 1.82x BM2 correction does not change conclusion (t_c >> 13.8 Gyr for all halos)
